//: Which pull request workflows start a run on every head, and why (scripts/ci/pr_trigger_paths.py).
A workflow run takes a queue slot even when every job in it skips, so a workflow that decides by the changed
paths gets them as its trigger `paths:` (derived: generated from its decider's own source, `check` keeps them
equal). Every other pull_request or pull_request_target workflow without `paths:` is listed under every_pr with
the reason it must start on every head; `detect` fails on one that is in neither list.

.github/workflows/classic-api-guard.yml.why: fails into main and warns into feat-cmux-next only when a guarded classic auto-deploy path changes

.github/workflows/classic-frozen-guard.y.why: holds a pull request into main only when it changes a classic-frozen path

.github/workflows/rust-workspaces.yml.why: checks Cargo manifests and locks, then builds the run workspaces a change reaches; the feat-cmux-next push still runs it whole

every_pr..github/workflows/backend-migrations.yml: produces `backend migrations applied`, required on main: a required context must report on every pull request (tests/test_ci_required_checks_have_no_path_filters.py; #17415 scoped it and every other PR went unmergeable)
every_pr..github/workflows/ci-pr-closed-cancel.ym: closed only: one run per pull request, not per head, cancelling the closed PR's queued CI
every_pr..github/workflows/cmux-next-batch.yml: the batch queue's debounce: every pull request event into feat-cmux-next feeds next_batch.py, whatever it changes
every_pr..github/workflows/cmux-next-fast-gates.y: posts cmux-next/fast-gates, which merge_hold reads at every head; its path skip lives in its fast-check-route job (lane/fast-check-path-skips)
every_pr..github/workflows/cmux-next-pr-autofix-c: closed only: one run per pull request, not per head
every_pr..github/workflows/cmux-next-pr-closed-ca: closed only: one run per pull request, not per head
every_pr..github/workflows/cmux-next-react-doctor: produces `React Doctor (changed React projects)`, required on feat-cmux-next: it must report on every head
every_pr..github/workflows/cmux-tui-spec.yml: produces `clippy (changed cmux-tui packages)`, required on feat-cmux-next: it must report on every head
every_pr..github/workflows/docs-only-fallback.yml: unfiltered by design (scripts/ci/docs_only_paths.py FALLBACK): its gate runs only for a pull request of more than 300 files or a full-ci/dev-build label, which `paths:` cannot see, and calls the filtered workflows that should have started
every_pr..github/workflows/ios-e2e.yml: builds the Mac and iOS apps, which read most of the tree; its route skips only prose and images, and docs paths-ignore belongs to the desktop lane
every_pr..github/workflows/language-boundaries.ym: judges the language of every added or changed source file anywhere in the tree
every_pr..github/workflows/merge-freeze.yml: `merge freeze` is a merge gate on feat-cmux-next: it reads open freeze issues for every pull request, whatever it changes
every_pr..github/workflows/pr-body-checks.yml: reads the pull request body and labels, which no paths filter sees
every_pr..github/workflows/pr-router.yml: the router itself: it reads every changed path of each feat-cmux-next head to decide which workflows start, so it starts on every head
